title: Biwi Ho To Aisi
desc: Suraj secretly marries Shalu, a village belle, defying his domineering mother Kamla. To drive Shalu away, Kamla falsely accuses her of stealing jewellery and money.

title: Vivah - Journey From Engagment To Marriage
desc: Poonam, an orphan, is engaged to Prem from a wealthy family. Just two days before the wedding, her house catches fire, leaving her with first-degree burns.

title: Singh Saab The Great
desc: Singh Saab is an honest and responsible tax officer, but the cunning Bhoodev plots against him. To stand up for what is right, Singh uses a clever and unique plan to teach Bhoodev a strong lesson.

title: Uri - The Surgical Strike
desc: After a deadly terrorist attack in Uri, Major Vihaan Singh Shergill leads a covert operation to eliminate the terrorists responsible, executing a high-risk mission deep across the border.

title: Mrs. Chatterjee Vs Norway
desc: Debika Chatterjee fights Norwegian authorities to regain custody of her children, battling cultural bias and legal hurdles in a foreign land.

title: Khalnayak
desc: Inspector Ram arrests notorious criminal Ballu, but when Ballu escapes and ruins Ram's reputation, his fiancee Ganga sets a trap-only to face trouble when Ballu unexpectedly falls for her.

title: Jai Santoshi Maa
desc: Mahima marries Anuraag and endures hostility from her in-laws. With faith and love, she works to win them over and create a peaceful, happy home together for all.

title: Apne Paraye
desc: Wealthy Sidheshwari hands over household control to her sister-in-law Sheila, but peace is soon threatened when Harish arrives with his cunning wife Naintara, who plots to manipulate her.

title: Maine Pyar Kiya
desc: Prem and Suman's love story faces a tough test when family feuds drive them apart. Can Prem overcome the obstacles and prove he's deserving of Suman's heart?

title: Ek Rishta: The Bond Of Love
desc: Ajay's relationship with his powerful businessman father is strained, but when he discovers his brother-in-law's malicious plans, he rises to protect his family.

title: Mission Raniganj : The Great Bharat Rescue
desc: Jaswant Singh Gill, a mining engineer, bravely leads a rescue mission to save 65 miners stuck inside a flooded coal mine, risking everything for their lives and safety.

title: Aranmanai 4
desc: A man investigates his sister's suspicious death, uncovering dark secrets that spiral into chaos and terror as he learns far more than he ever expected.

title: Sitaare Zameen Par
desc: After a DUI, an arrogant basketball coach must train Neurodivergent adults for community service. His initial prejudice fades as his players show him a new perspective on life.

title: Iqbal
desc: Iqbal, a hearing- and speech-impaired boy, dreams of playing for India. When his condition blocks his selection, he turns to a retired coach to train him for his dream.
